title: WPA Institutional Maturity Roadmap 2026-2030
principle: Architecture is not maturity. Maturity is demonstrated through verified evidence, governed activation and external validation.

phases.name: Evidence and governance lock
objectives: Complete record-level Master List verification workflow and publish measured progress.
Form AAB through written acceptance and conflict-of-interest declarations.
Stabilise Institute Index methodology as a public candidate with documented weights, criteria, examples and correction rules.
Expand DOI-backed PSPI / Protocolometry case-study corpus.
Maintain Canonical Metrics & Status as the single public status reference.
Keep official certificate issuance disabled until the governed backend is live.
exit_gates: Institute Index methodology has completed documented review.
Master List verification progress is computed from record-level evidence logs, not estimates.

phases.name: Controlled activation
objectives: Activate only services with operational ownership, privacy controls, evidence trails and human review.
Launch professional certificate issuance only if enrolment, identity, assessment, authorisation and verification backend controls are live.
Publish Journal governance and peer-review workflow with visible editorial responsibility.
Increase external reviewers and institutional collaborators.
exit_gates: Governed student operations backend is live and tested before any official credential issuance.
Certificate language remains non-degree and legally accurate.
Journal editorial and review process is operational rather than announced only.

phases.name: Institutional scaling decision
objectives: Assess whether legal entity formation is operationally necessary for contracts, staffing, payments, partnerships, grants or governance.
If needed, choose legal form only after jurisdiction-specific professional advice and a defined operating model.
Scale verified institutional services without mixing analytical independence with paid outcomes.
exit_gates: Legal form, if pursued, follows function and compliance need rather than prestige signalling.
Academic/research outputs and commercial services have visibly separated governance and conflict-of-interest rules.

phases.name: External validation and network depth
objectives: Deepen partnerships with academic, professional and technology institutions based on documented outputs.
Run external methodology reviews for Protocolometry, Institute Index and human-governed AI workflows.
Publish longitudinal evidence showing correction, repeatability and outcome improvement.
exit_gates: Multiple external reviewers or partners have documented participation.
Core claims are supported by repeatable public evidence rather than internal architecture descriptions.

phases.name: Reference-center maturity review
objectives: Evaluate whether WPA has earned reference-center positioning through publications, methods, verified datasets, external governance and practical use.
Publish a five-year transparency and correction report.
Retire, merge or archive modules that did not produce sustained public value.
exit_gates: Reference-center language is used only if supported by documented external use and validation.
Public architecture remains simpler than internal operating architecture.
Governance, evidence, correction and human authority remain controlling principles.

non_goals: No promise of accreditation by a target year.
No promise of legal registration by a target year.
No activation of certificates merely to appear mature.
No world-first or global-leader claim without independent evidence.
No conversion of AI capability into institutional authority.
